faqs.question: Who are your doctors and medical team?
faqs.answer: Cross-Care has a dedicated team of medical coordinators, licensed healthcare consultants, and specialists who work with our Thai hospital partners. Our medical team includes general medicine consultants for initial assessments and specialist coordinators for complex cases. All team members are experienced in Myanmar-Thailand medical referrals and cross-cultural patient care.

faqs.question: Can I speak with your doctors directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, our medical consultants are available for initial consultations and will coordinate with Thai specialists for your specific needs. Contact us to schedule a consultation with our medical team.

faqs.question: What qualifications do your team members have?
faqs.answer: Our team includes licensed medical professionals, certified translation specialists, and trained patient advocates. All members are experienced in Myanmar-Thailand healthcare coordination and emergency response protocols.

faqs.question: How do I start the process?
faqs.answer: Fill out our contact form on the website or message us on Facebook. Our team will guide you through the initial consultation process.

faqs.question: What are the costs involved?
faqs.answer: Costs vary depending on the medical treatment needed and hospital chosen. Contact us directly for personalized pricing information based on your specific medical requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide translation services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide translation and interpretation services in Myanmar, English, and Thai to ensure clear communication with medical staff.

faqs.question: How long does the process take?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on the medical urgency and treatment type. Emergency cases can be coordinated within 24-48 hours, while routine appointments typically take 1-2 weeks to arrange.

faqs.question: What documents do I need?
faqs.answer: You'll need medical records, passport, and any previous test results. Our team will guide you through the complete documentation requirements.

faqs.question: Do you help with accommodation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide guidance on accommodation options near the hospitals, including patient-friendly hotels and extended stay facilities.

faqs.question: What if I need emergency treatment?
faqs.answer: For medical emergencies, contact local emergency services immediately. For urgent medical coordination, reach out to us directly and we'll provide priority assistance.

faqs.question: Are your services available 24/7?
faqs.answer: We monitor our communication channels regularly and provide emergency coordination support. Contact us through Facebook or our website form for urgent matters.

medical_response_guidelines.purpose: Guidelines for responding to medical questions
medical_response_guidelines.approach: Provide brief, helpful information while emphasizing professional medical consultation

common_conditions.heart_disease: Heart conditions require specialized cardiology care. Thailand has excellent cardiac centers with advanced treatments including bypass surgery, angioplasty, and heart valve procedures.
common_conditions.cancer: Cancer treatment in Thailand includes comprehensive oncology services with chemotherapy, radiation therapy, immunotherapy, and surgical options. Early detection and treatment planning are crucial.
common_conditions.diabetes: Diabetes management involves blood sugar monitoring, medication, diet control, and regular check-ups. Thai hospitals offer comprehensive diabetes care programs.
common_conditions.hypertension: High blood pressure can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and regular monitoring. Thai medical facilities provide excellent cardiovascular care.
common_conditions.kidney_disease: Kidney conditions may require dialysis, medication, or transplant procedures. Thailand has advanced nephrology departments and dialysis centers.
common_conditions.stroke: Stroke requires immediate emergency care followed by rehabilitation. Thai hospitals have specialized stroke units and comprehensive recovery programs.
common_conditions.orthopedic: Bone and joint problems can be treated with physiotherapy, medication, or surgery. Thailand is renowned for orthopedic procedures and joint replacements.

emergency_symptoms.chest_pain: Chest pain could indicate a heart attack - seek immediate emergency medical attention
emergency_symptoms.difficulty_breathing: Severe breathing problems require immediate emergency care
emergency_symptoms.severe_headache: Sudden severe headache could indicate stroke - seek emergency care immediately
emergency_symptoms.loss_consciousness: Loss of consciousness requires immediate emergency medical attention

medical_response_guidelines.disclaimer: This information is for general guidance only and does not replace professional medical advice. Contact Cross-Care to consult with our doctors for personalized medical guidance and proper diagnosis.
medical_response_guidelines.consultation_reminder: For any medical concerns, please contact Cross-Care to speak with our medical team who can provide proper consultation and coordinate with Thai specialists for your specific needs.
